body:
Plan for syncing the shared checkout (owner-directed: "coordinate and get this work safely merged").

After PR #10 merges, local main fast-forwards to origin/main. The only blockers are 20 untracked files in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/scalafim that origin now tracks:
- 6 are byte-identical to origin's versions.
- 14 are drafts from 2026-09-13 09:06-10:36 that origin committed in finished form later that day (37dba04c, cd85320f, 79a8b7d1). The evidence shows they are superseded:
  - the spike evidence draft is schema v2, while origin has v3 recording the admission;
  - the epic draft cites pre-publication e071e83b, while origin cites 528c302e;
  - the parity suites differ only in formatting.
- None has a Mote reservation, and none was modified after 09-13.

What I will do:
- Copy all 20 files, with a sha256 manifest and diffs against origin, to ~/scalafim-sync-archive/20260930/.
- Remove only those 20 untracked files, then run git merge --ff-only.
- Touch nothing tracked or uncommitted. In particular, the modified fit ResultManifestWriterSuite.scala (09-29) is not affected by the fast-forward.

If you own a draft and it holds work origin lacks, restore it from the archive. Object here before PR #10 merges if you need me to hold.
